faq.heading: FAQ
faq.whatAns: JAANI is a civic-tech desk that extracts facts, contacts decision makers and lets every citizen escalate with verifiable evidence.
faq.howAns: From link to letter in under thirty seconds. Templates are generated instantly and contacts are pre-verified.
faq.privacyAns: Drafts stay on your device. Attachments upload securely and can be deleted anytime.

newsAnalysis.title: News Analysis (What's in the news?)
newsAnalysis.disclaimer: This analysis is generated by artificial intelligence and is not legal advice. Government bodies and RTI officers come from JAANI's RTI dataset.
newsAnalysis.aiUnavailableBody: No summary, highlights or category are shown rather than a guessed one. The government bodies and RTI officer below come from the RTI dataset, not from AI. Try again in a minute.
newsAnalysis.rtiTargetOffice: Suggested office for an RTI request:
newsAnalysis.relatedVerified: Possibly related (AI-suggested, matched to the RTI dataset)
newsAnalysis.sameNewsEmpty: No other newspaper coverage of this exact story was found.
newsAnalysis.factChecksNote: Independent fact-checkers' reports that concern the same claim or event. They are not a verdict on this article.
newsAnalysis.preservingDetail: On first download the server captures the page itself, takes two screenshots, hashes and timestamps everything, then builds one PDF — this can take up to two minutes.
